Variants.Content: Fallwood City is located between the eastern woodland and the coastal road in the Stormlands. It is a local castle in the Stormlands lord system. It is located near the rainforest and Shipbreaker Bay, and is responsible for protecting the manor, roads and recruiting soldiers; in the battle for the throne, its ownership depends on the alliance between Storm's End and the surrounding lords.
Entry Felwood Local families also rely on fishing, salt production, docks, volcanic rock fields and narrow sea navigation; if any road, well or dock fails, the price falls first on them.

Entry Felwood They'll also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of Dragonstone's waters; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hooves.

Entry Felwood If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Felwood A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Felwood They care about fishing, salt industry, wharves, volcanic rock fields and narrow sea shipping. They also care about whether seeds are left after harvesting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
